item.title: Lesbian 'The Real L Word' star Francine Beppu died in her home at 43
item.description: The Real L Word’s Francine Beppu has died at 43.The reality TV star’s death was announced by a family spokesperson to TMZ on Monday.Beppu passed away on Feb. 17 in her home in Honolulu, but her family has yet to disclose the cause of death. item.title: Trump administration scrubs LGBTQ+ questions from federal surveys
item.description: Hundreds of federal surveys have removed questions tied to sexual orientation and gender identity, according to a new report from the Williams Institute, which cites President Trump’s executive orders as the reason.The report cites the scrubbing of the questions as made by “non-substantative change requests.” This means that the removal requests lacked a valid reason or evidence to back up the rationale. item.description: The first openly lesbian Latine judge in Texas, Denise Hernández, was awarded the Bettie Naylor Award by the Human Rights Campaign last month for her outstanding dedication to LGBTQ+ rights and for paving the way for better regulations in courtrooms. item.title: How can PrEP use among Black people be improved?
item.description: Black patients account for 42 percent of new HIV diagnoses in the U.S., despite making up just 13 percent of the country’s population. So why is PrEP use so low?AIDSVu released findings in 2023 that showed Blacks represented only 14 percent of PrEP users.
